title: SYNAPSE Console
subtitle: Sign in with your operator credentials. Your refresh token lives in an HttpOnly cookie; nothing operator-identifying is logged client-side (FE-INV-019).
preview.badge_title_view: Open preview: no sign-in. Every visitor can read this console; nobody can change anything.
preview.badge_title_act: Open preview: no sign-in. Every visitor holds ops authority and can act. For a local machine only.
authority.title: Insufficient authority
authority.open_view: Preview access is view only, so actions stay closed to every visitor.
authority.open_act: Preview access acts at ops level and never higher; this surface needs more than preview access grants.
authority.unavailable: No access was granted: the gateway could not be reached or refused a preview grant. Surfaces you can read still show their own live state.
login.dormant_body: This console runs in open preview access: it opens without sign-in, and operator sign-in stays dormant until it is activated.
